nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Responds immediately. Do not add a Respond to Webhook node unless responseMode is changed to responseNode.

nodes.name: Fetch Upload Task
nodes.notes: Uses upload_task_id from Parse Upload Task ID. The previous workflow referenced task_id, which was undefined.

nodes.name: Validate New Document
nodes.notes: Validates the uploaded Paperless task and extracts the new document id. Uses upload_task_id, not task_id.

nodes.name: Delete Old Document
nodes.notes: DESTRUCTIVE: disables rollback by deleting the old Paperless document after the new one is confirmed and metadata is patched. Disable this node during your first test run.

nodes.name: Build ASN Restore Body
nodes.notes: Only emits an item when the old document had an archive serial number. This avoids an empty PATCH when ASN was unset.

nodes.name: Restore Archive Serial Number
nodes.notes: Runs after the old document is deleted so the same ASN no longer violates Paperless uniqueness constraints.

nodes.name: Guard OCR Trigger Tags
nodes.notes: Option A guard: continue only when Paperless has already assigned ocr-processing and the document does not have ocr-done. Replacement docs uploaded with ocr-done stop here.

nodes.name: Call OCR Service
nodes.notes: fullResponse:true so we can read X-OCR-Skipped from headers. When the service detects an existing text layer, it returns the input PDF byte-for-byte unchanged with X-OCR-Skipped: true; uploading that back to Paperless would fail as a duplicate, so the workflow branches on this header below.

nodes.name: Detect OCR Skipped
nodes.notes: Reads X-OCR-Skipped from Call OCR Service response headers and exposes it as $json.ocr_skipped for the next IF node.

nodes.name: Branch On OCR Skipped
nodes.notes: TRUE branch: PDF already had a text layer, skip the upload/delete dance and just retag the old doc as ocr-done. FALSE branch: continue the normal Build Replacement Metadata flow.

nodes.name: Tag Old Doc Done
nodes.notes: Skipped-OCR terminator. Removes ocr-processing + ocr-inflight from the old doc and adds ocr-done. No new document is created.
